title: Product Equivalence Recalibration Pretest
purpose: Evaluate baseline-choice balance and perceived nutritional objective-fit/desirability of conservatively recalibrated energy-bar profiles (Version A), without an AI recommendation.

metric.notes: Each revised profile is equidistant from the stated goals; computed for both profiles separately.

consent.status: Institution-approved consent text supplied by researcher; retained unchanged in v1.3.
consent.title: Informed Consent
paragraphs: I hereby confirm that I agree to participate in a study about decision making in various fields.
Study goal: to assess product choice accuracy.
Potential benefits from the research: contribution to the field of decision making.
I understand that if, for any reason, I will choose to stop my participation I can do it at any time and without cost and will not be required to explain my decision.
In the event that during or following the experiment you will feel uncomfortable, please contact the principal investigator(s) through the email listed below.
Please indicate whether you agree to participate in the study.
response_options: I disagree and wish to decline my participation
consent.decline_action: Stop experimental procedure and do not assign or display experimental treatment; follow approved platform exit handling
consent.missing_in_supplied_text: Approved consent refers to a contact email not included in supplied copy; verify approved participant contact channel separately and do not alter approved wording.
consent.review_note: Preserve institution-approved consent verbatim. Verify that approved participant contact channel, debrief and applicable ethics coverage match the study. Do not independently edit approved wording.

general_instructions.title: General instructions
rules: This task requires your full attention.
Please complete this task on a desktop or laptop computer only.
Please complete the task in one sitting, without breaks.
From now until the end of the task, please do not browse the web or use your mobile phone or other devices.
general_instructions.warning: Failing to comply with these requirements may invalidate your participation.

choice.text: Which energy bar would you choose?

fit.text_template: How well does Energy Bar {bar} match the stated nutritional objectives?

desirability.text_template: How desirable do you find Energy Bar {bar} overall?

analysis.primary_endpoint: choice_X, baseline preference for profile X versus Y
analysis.primary_test: Report X choice proportion and exact 95% CI; two-sided exact binomial test vs .5 is descriptive, not equivalence evidence.
secondary_tests: Paired equivalence (TOST) for desirability_X minus desirability_Y, prespecified bounds [-0.50,+0.50] points; show 90% CI.
Paired equivalence (TOST) for fit_X minus fit_Y, prespecified bounds [-0.50,+0.50] points; show 90% CI.
diagnostics: Counterbalancing and attrition audit by configuration
analysis.practical_screen_rule: Calibration target: X share approximately 45% to 55% (descriptive). Do not interpret nonsignificance as equivalence; formally validate choice with a prespecified equivalence margin (proposed 40% to 60%) in an adequately powered independent sample.
analysis.statistics_caveat: Statistical nonsignificance does not establish equivalence. Report magnitude and confidence intervals; if claiming formal equivalence, prespecify bounds and run TOST.
analysis.pilot_sample_size: Version A diagnostic pilot N ~40-50 new participants across four cells (10-13 per cell); adjust based on precision, not formal equivalence power.
analysis.missingness: All displayed responses required; complete-case analytic file excludes incomplete/withdrawn/timed-out. No imputation. Platform compensation adjudicated separately.
analysis.preregistration: Not yet; researcher to review after pretest design finalized.

deployment.persistent_assignment: Qualtrics Embedded Data or trusted server state; localStorage demo only
warnings: Deploy only with approved consent/ethics coverage and investigator contact information.
The single-file HTML does not itself save results to a server.
deployment.handoff_policy: After validating the final answer, display a brief thank-you for 2 seconds, then post the payload to the Qualtrics parent. The Qualtrics bridge must record the fields on the survey page and advance to its End-of-Survey element. GitHub Pages does not persist responses; the app never directly navigates to Prolific or issues completion codes.
deployment.participant_header_footer: Hide study name/banner and study ID/version footer in Participant Mode; show in Researcher Preview.
deployment.qualtrics_ack_note: Receipt by the iframe parent confirms only client-side handoff, not durable server persistence. Qualtrics must submit the page to save the response; live Prolific redirect is configured by Qualtrics.
